tools.name: tf_briefing
tools.description: Fetches a real-time world-state snapshot composed from BTC ticker, Fear and Greed Index, recent earthquakes (USGS), top Hacker News story count, and ISS crew. Returns JSON. No auth required. Cache TTL 60s. Use when the agent needs a quick global pulse before deciding what to investigate.

tools.name: tf_btc_price
tools.description: Fetches the current Bitcoin price in USD with 24h change, high, low, and volume. Source: Binance with CoinCap fallback. Cache TTL 15s. No auth required. Use for crypto trading decisions or when the agent needs a fresh BTC quote.

tools.name: tf_fear_greed
tools.description: Fetches the current Crypto Fear and Greed Index value (0-100) with classification label (Extreme Fear, Fear, Neutral, Greed, Extreme Greed). Source: Alternative.me. Cache TTL 5min. Use as a sentiment signal for crypto trading decisions.

tools.name: tf_crypto_movers
tools.description: Fetches the top 15 cryptocurrencies sorted by 24h price change. Includes price, market cap, and percentage move. Source: CoinGecko/CoinLore. Cache TTL 30s. Use when the agent needs to surface notable crypto market moves.

tools.name: tf_predictions
tools.description: Fetches active Polymarket prediction markets sorted by 24h volume. Each market includes question, outcomes, and volume. Cache TTL 60s. Use when the agent needs market-implied probabilities on world events (elections, sports, macro).

tools.name: tf_earthquakes
tools.description: Fetches recent earthquakes magnitude 2.5 or greater from USGS. Returns count and most recent quake details (magnitude, place, time). Cache TTL 2min. Use for disaster monitoring or when the agent needs current seismic activity.

tools.name: tf_climate_earthquakes

tools.name: tf_service_status

tools.name: tf_economic_data
tools.description: Fetches latest FRED economic indicators: Fed funds rate, CPI, unemployment rate, GDP growth. Cache TTL 1h. Use when the agent needs current US macro indicators. For deeper macro (treasury yields, forex, commodities, indices) use tf_premium_macro.

tools.name: tf_forex

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tf_climate_earthquakes, tf_hf_trending, tf_harnesses, tf_ai_stack_cves, tf_premium_feed_reliability, tf_premium_feed_reliability_history · Private data: tf_ai_stack_cves, tf_payment_buy_credits, tf_payment_confirm, tf_payment_balance, tf_payment_history · Public sink: tf_premium_github_velocity, tf_payment_buy_credits, tf_payment_confirm.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tf_climate_earthquakes, tf_hf_trending, tf_harnesses, tf_ai_stack_cves, tf_premium_feed_reliability, tf_premium_feed_reliability_history · Private data: tf_ai_stack_cves, tf_payment_buy_credits, tf_payment_confirm, tf_payment_balance, tf_payment_history · Public sink: tf_premium_github_velocity, tf_payment_buy_credits, tf_payment_confirm

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
